events.definition: Tumor cells with optically clear cytoplasm arranged in compact nests or alveolar groups separated by delicate septa.
visual_cues: clear polygonal cells in rounded nests
thin fibrovascular septa between alveolar groups
events.prognostic_rationale: Nested growth reflects the canonical organization of clear cell renal carcinoma and provides a reference state for recognizing divergent patterns.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing clear cell nested-alveolar architecture
photomicrograph demonstrating nests of clear renal tumor cells separated by delicate septa, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by rounded alveolar groups of optically clear polygonal cells
microscopic H&E appearance of nested clear cell carcinoma in renal tissue

events.definition: Neoplastic clear cells form small acini or tubules with recognizable central lumina.
visual_cues: round gland-like lumina
cuboidal clear cells lining small tubules
events.prognostic_rationale: Tubular differentiation records a distinct epithelial growth program within a morphologically heterogeneous tumor.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing acinar and tubular differentiation in renal clear cell carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating small lumina lined by clear neoplastic cells, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by compact acini and tubules among clear tumor cells
microscopic H&E appearance of gland-forming clear cell renal carcinoma

events.definition: Tumor cells cover branching or rounded fibrovascular cores to create a localized papillary configuration.
visual_cues: fibrovascular cores with adherent tumor cells
branching papillary fronds
exclusion_cues: pseudopapillae caused only by cell dropout
events.prognostic_rationale: A papillary component represents architectural divergence that may accompany intratumoral evolution.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing papillary growth in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating tumor-lined fibrovascular cores, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by branching papillary fronds formed by renal tumor cells
microscopic H&E appearance of a papillary component within clear cell carcinoma

events.definition: A localized tumor component is composed of compact cells with granular eosinophilic rather than optically clear cytoplasm.
visual_cues: densely eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
compact cohesive tumor cell groups
events.prognostic_rationale: Eosinophilic change can mark a divergent cellular phenotype and increased morphologic heterogeneity.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing a compact eosinophilic component in renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating cohesive tumor cells with granular pink cytoplasm, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by eosinophilic renal tumor cells contrasting with clear cell areas
microscopic H&E appearance of compact granular-cell differentiation in clear cell renal carcinoma

events.definition: Large discohesive tumor cells show eccentric nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm.
visual_cues: eccentric vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli
abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm in discohesive cells
events.prognostic_rationale: Rhabdoid morphology is a recognizable form of tumor dedifferentiation and aggressive local behavior.

photomicrograph demonstrating large discohesive cells with eccentric nuclei and dense cytoplasm, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by rhabdoid tumor cells with prominent nucleoli
microscopic H&E appearance of a rhabdoid component in clear cell renal carcinoma

events.definition: A carcinoma component transitions into malignant spindle cells growing in intersecting fascicles or disordered sheets.
visual_cues: pleomorphic spindle cells in fascicles
transition between epithelial and spindle-cell components
events.prognostic_rationale: Sarcomatoid transformation reflects marked dedifferentiation and enhanced invasive capacity.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing sarcomatoid spindle-cell transformation in renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating pleomorphic malignant spindle cells in fascicles, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by transition from clear cell carcinoma to sarcomatoid morphology
microscopic H&E appearance of a spindle-cell sarcomatoid component in kidney tumor

events.definition: Tumor nuclei contain conspicuous eosinophilic nucleoli readily visible within enlarged vesicular nuclei.
visual_cues: large eosinophilic nucleoli
enlarged vesicular tumor nuclei
exclusion_cues: small uniform nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli
events.prognostic_rationale: Nucleolar prominence captures nuclear-grade morphology associated with altered cellular differentiation.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing prominent nucleoli in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating enlarged vesicular nuclei with conspicuous eosinophilic nucleoli, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by renal tumor cells with readily visible macronucleoli
microscopic H&E appearance of nucleolar prominence in kidney carcinoma

events.definition: A tumor region exhibits pronounced variation in nuclear size, shape, chromasia, and cellular form.
visual_cues: bizarre enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei
substantial cell-to-cell size variation
exclusion_cues: reactive stromal cells outside tumor nests
events.prognostic_rationale: Marked pleomorphism reflects loss of organized differentiation and genomic instability at the morphologic level.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing marked tumor cell pleomorphism in renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating bizarre variably sized hyperchromatic tumor nuclei, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by pronounced nuclear and cellular atypia
microscopic H&E appearance of pleomorphic clear cell renal carcinoma

events.definition: A localized viable tumor region contains numerous readily identifiable mitotic figures.
visual_cues: multiple mitotic figures among viable tumor cells
condensed chromosomes in dividing cells
events.prognostic_rationale: Frequent mitoses provide direct morphologic evidence of active tumor-cell proliferation.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing brisk mitotic activity in renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating numerous mitotic figures among viable tumor cells, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by frequent dividing clear cell carcinoma cells
microscopic H&E appearance of a proliferative renal tumor focus

events.definition: Tumor cells display abnormal multipolar, asymmetric, or otherwise malformed mitotic figures.
visual_cues: multipolar mitoses
asymmetric clumped mitotic chromosomes
events.prognostic_rationale: Atypical mitoses are a morphologic manifestation of disordered cell division and chromosomal instability.

photomicrograph demonstrating multipolar and malformed tumor-cell mitoses, H&E stain

microscopic H&E appearance of atypical cell division in clear cell renal carcinoma

events.definition: Geographic zones of dead tumor retain ghost-like architecture with eosinophilic cytoplasm and nuclear loss.
visual_cues: geographic eosinophilic ghost tumor
abrupt transition from viable tumor to karyolytic necrosis
events.prognostic_rationale: Coagulative necrosis indicates that tumor growth has exceeded local tissue viability and perfusion.

photomicrograph demonstrating geographic eosinophilic ghost tumor with nuclear loss, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by abrupt viable-to-necrotic tumor transition

events.definition: Extravasated erythrocytes and blood lakes dissect through or replace a localized tumor region.
visual_cues: blood-filled spaces outside intact vessels
erythrocytes dissecting between tumor nests
events.prognostic_rationale: Hemorrhage reflects vascular fragility and disturbed perfusion within the tumor microenvironment.

photomicrograph demonstrating extravasated erythrocytes and blood lakes within tumor, H&E stain

events.definition: A tumor region contains macroscopic or microscopic cyst-like spaces formed by degeneration and tissue loss.
visual_cues: cystic spaces within tumor
attenuated or degenerative lining around luminal cavities
exclusion_cues: pure hemorrhagic lakes filled with erythrocytes
events.prognostic_rationale: Cystic degeneration records regional tissue remodeling and variable viability within the tumor.

photomicrograph demonstrating tumor-associated cystic spaces and tissue loss, H&E stain

microscopic H&E appearance of cystic change in a kidney tumor

events.definition: A dense branching network of thin-walled capillaries courses between nests of clear tumor cells.
visual_cues: thin-walled branching capillaries
fine vascular mesh surrounding clear cell nests
events.prognostic_rationale: The capillary network is the principal visible vascular phenotype supporting clear cell tumor tissue.

photomicrograph demonstrating thin branching vessels between clear tumor cells, H&E stain

events.definition: Cohesive tumor cells are present within endothelial-lined small vascular channels adjacent to or within the tumor.
visual_cues: tumor emboli inside endothelial-lined small vessels
attachment of tumor cells to a vascular lumen
exclusion_cues: free tissue fragments without an endothelial boundary
events.prognostic_rationale: Small-vessel invasion provides a morphologic route for hematogenous dissemination.

events.definition: A large venous lumen contains a cohesive expansile mass of viable renal carcinoma cells, often with associated fibrin or blood.
visual_cues: large vessel lumen occupied by cohesive tumor
tumor mass bordered by venous wall or endothelium
exclusion_cues: bland fibrin thrombus without tumor cells
events.prognostic_rationale: Extension into a major vein demonstrates large-vessel invasion and access to systemic circulation.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing a venous tumor thrombus from renal cell carcinoma

histologic section characterized by renal carcinoma filling a vein with associated blood

events.definition: A compressed fibrous band forms a discrete boundary between the renal tumor and adjacent parenchyma.
visual_cues: continuous collagenous rim around tumor
compressed renal tissue external to a fibrous boundary
exclusion_cues: irregular infiltrative edge without a rim
events.prognostic_rationale: A pseudocapsule defines the local tumor-host interface against which focal invasion can be assessed.

events.definition: Irregular tongues or nests of tumor traverse a pre-existing fibrous pseudocapsule into surrounding tissue.
visual_cues: tumor nests crossing a collagenous rim
discontinuous pseudocapsule with outward tumor tongues
exclusion_cues: tumor confined to the inner capsule surface
events.prognostic_rationale: Capsular penetration is direct morphologic evidence that the tumor has breached a local containment interface.
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology image showing renal carcinoma penetrating a fibrous pseudocapsule
photomicrograph demonstrating tumor nests crossing a collagenous capsule, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by discontinuous pseudocapsule and outward invasive tongues
microscopic H&E appearance of pseudocapsular invasion by clear cell carcinoma

events.definition: Irregular carcinoma nests infiltrate among and replace native renal tubules or glomeruli at the tumor boundary.
visual_cues: tumor nests interdigitating with renal tubules
entrapped glomeruli or tubules at an irregular edge
events.prognostic_rationale: Parenchymal infiltration captures active local invasion beyond an expansile growth front.

photomicrograph demonstrating tumor nests interdigitating with native tubules, H&E stain
histologic section characterized by entrapped glomeruli at an irregular tumor edge
microscopic H&E appearance of infiltrative kidney tumor-parenchyma interface

events.definition: Renal carcinoma nests or cords extend irregularly between adipocytes in perinephric fat.

irregular nests beyond the renal outer boundary
exclusion_cues: fat entrapped within the tumor center
smooth contact with adipose tissue without infiltration
events.prognostic_rationale: Extension into perinephric adipose tissue demonstrates spread beyond the renal parenchymal compartment.

photomicrograph demonstrating clear tumor nests between mature fat cells, H&E stain

events.definition: Tumor extends into renal sinus soft tissue, fat, or vascular structures at the hilar interface.

irregular extension into hilar soft tissue
exclusion_cues: peripheral fat invasion remote from sinus structures
events.prognostic_rationale: The renal sinus contains abundant vascular and lymphatic channels that provide routes for regional extension.

photomicrograph demonstrating tumor in hilar fat near large vessels, H&E stain

events.definition: Small irregular groups and cords of tumor cells separate from the main mass and permeate adjacent stroma.

events.prognostic_rationale: Budding provides a localized morphologic sign of tumor-cell detachment and invasive transition.

photomicrograph demonstrating single cells and tiny tumor clusters detached from larger nests, H&E stain

events.definition: Small mature lymphocytes permeate viable tumor nests and directly contact carcinoma cells.
